_synthetic: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Every person, school, district, provider and message in this file is fictional and was written for this repository. No real child, family, school, district or employee is described. Nothing here is a record of anything that happened.
description: The two quarterly progress reports the district issued during the semester, written to the pattern real ones follow. They narrate the GOAL and are silent on the SERVICE: a progress code, a sentence or two of narrative, sometimes a percentage, and one unquantified boilerplate line about delivery. There is not a single session count or session date in either document. That is the point - the school's own compliance artifact, arriving exactly on time, is worth zero dated evidence about whether the promised minutes were delivered. The second report covers the entire speech vacancy and disposes of it in one sentence.

items.subject: IEP Progress Report - Quarter 1 - Maya R.
items.body:
UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT
IEP PROGRESS REPORT

Student: Maya R.            DOB: 2018-03-14
School: Lincoln Elementary  Grade: 3
Case manager: T. Alvarez    IEP date: 2026-09-01
Reporting period: Quarter 1  Date issued: 2026-11-06

Progress reports are issued concurrent with the issuance of report cards.

PROGRESS CODES
SP = Sufficient Progress being made to achieve annual goal within duration of IEP
IP = Insufficient Progress demonstrated to meet this annual goal
M  = Mastered
NI = Not been provided Instruction on this goal
ES = Emerging Skill
PH = Progress being made but hampered by new circumstances

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
GOAL 1 (Speech-Language)
Given a visual model, Maya will produce /s/ in the initial position of words
at the phrase level with 80% accuracy across 3 consecutive data collection
opportunities.
Measurement: provider data collection
Progress code: SP
Narrative: Maya continues to make progress toward this goal. She is
performing at 60 percent accuracy with initial /s/ words at the phrase level
with moderate verbal prompting. Services are being provided as outlined in
the IEP.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
GOAL 2 (Occupational Therapy)
Maya will form lowercase letters within the lines on raised-line paper in
4 of 5 trials with no more than one verbal prompt.
Measurement: work samples and provider data collection
Progress code: SP
Narrative: Maya is progressing at a rate expected to meet the annual goal by
the end of the IEP period. Current data: 3 of 5 trials with one prompt.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
GOAL 3 (Specialized Academic Instruction - Reading)
Maya will read grade-level decodable text at 70 words per minute with 95%
accuracy.
Measurement: curriculum-based measurement, biweekly
Progress code: ES
Narrative: Progress is emerging. Continued practice at home is recommended.
Data collection was limited this quarter.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
GOAL 4 (Specialized Academic Instruction - Math)
Maya will solve two-step word problems with 80% accuracy across 3 consecutive
probes.
Measurement: weekly probes
Progress code: SP
Narrative: Maya has made steady gains this quarter with continued support and
prompting.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
GOAL 5 (Social/Emotional - Counseling)
Maya will identify and name a coping strategy in 4 of 5 structured
opportunities.
Measurement: provider observation
Progress code: NI
Narrative: This goal has not been introduced this quarter.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Questions about this report may be directed to the case manager at the school
office.
